featured_reviews.review_text:
I’ve been going to this gym for a while now, and overall it’s been a really positive experience. The facility is clean, well-maintained, and has a wide range of equipment suitable for both beginners and experienced fitness enthusiasts. I also appreciate the variety of workout options available, including cardio machines, free weights, and functional training areas.

One of the best aspects of this gym is that it’s very budget-friendly. The membership fees are reasonable compared to other gyms in the area, and the value you get in terms of equipment, facilities, and support makes it totally worth it.

The only minor downside is that it can get a bit crowded during evenings, but that’s expected for a popular place. Overall, it’s a great gym for anyone looking to stay fit, build strength, or simply maintain a healthy lifestyle without spending too much.

featured_reviews.name: Jaykumar Patel
featured_reviews.review_text:
I can’t recommend this gym enough. The atmosphere is top-notch, and the fellow gym members are great. It's a supportive, friendly environment that makes working out actually enjoyable.

The highlight for me is my trainer, Jay. He’s absolutely amazing and I love my sessions with him. He’s knowledgeable, motivating, and knows exactly how to push me to get the results. If you're looking for a solid gym with a great community, this is the place!

featured_reviews.name: Gautam Solanki
featured_reviews.review_text:
I’ve been a long-term member at G9 Fitness Centres, and overall my experience has been very good. The gym offers a premium setup while still being budget friendly, which is one of the main reasons I’ve continued here. The equipment is well maintained and supports all types of fitness—whether it’s weight training, cardio, or general fitness.

The trainers and staff are supportive, polite, and always willing to guide when needed, especially helpful if you’re consistent with your workouts. The gym timings are very convenient, from 5:30 in the morning till 11:00 at night, so it’s easy to manage workouts with a busy schedule.

It can get slightly crowded during peak hours, but the overall environment remains positive and motivating. A reliable and comfortable gym, especially for long-term fitness goals. Definitely recommended.

featured_reviews.name: ritvik patel _143
featured_reviews.review_text:
Honest review after 1 month of experience:
1.There are no limitations to weight 40 kg of dumbbells are available, plates upto 400 kgs altogether and the most important part is the equipment and the machine advanced and easy to operate.
2.Trainer are very friendly they help us to improve our form and techniques and are certified as well as experienced soo we can trust them with our health conditions.
3. Starting 3 days the trainers guide us with every single machine in the gym and they stick around with us and look after our form and techniques.
4.Crowd is not at all aggressive and the management team and the staff members are very friendly and always try to bring best to us.
5.My favourite trainer is Qunal sir he is very friendly not at all strict and is very experienced.
6.Gym lighting is the most attractive part of the gym and the cleanliness is at top notch. The hose keeper 4 times a day clean the whole gym and that very impressive.
7.At last i will recommend u this gym cause of my experience.

featured_reviews.name: Amit Agarwal
featured_reviews.review_text: There is no proper coach in gym which led to injury. Coach present in the gym are busy with their phone and not interested in helping. Equipment are very old with proper weight describe. I m stuck by paying annual membership

featured_reviews.name: Ankit Dhali
featured_reviews.review_text:
G9 Fitness in Dahisar East is a well-equipped and clean gym, conveniently located just a short walk from Ovaripada Metro Station. It’s a great spot for anyone serious about fitness.

The gym has a wide range of modern machines for both strength training and cardio. All equipment is well-maintained and neatly arranged, making workouts smooth and efficient.

The trainers are one of the biggest strengths here. They’re knowledgeable, approachable, and truly invested in helping members progress. Whether you’re just starting out or already experienced, the trainers provide the right guidance and motivation.

G9 Fitness stays open till 11:30 PM, which is ideal for people with busy schedules. The flexible timing allows you to fit in a workout even after a long day.

A big plus is the steam room, which is perfect for post-workout recovery and relaxation.

Overall, this gym offers everything you’d want – good location, skilled trainers, great machines, extended hours, and a clean, supportive environment. Highly recommended if you’re in or around Dahisar and looking for a quality gym.

featured_reviews.name: kamlesh hire

The staff is friendly and knowledgeable, always ready to assist and motivate you in reaching your fitness goals. The variety of classes offered caters to all fitness levels, and the personal trainers are dedicated to helping you achieve results. I highly recommend G9 to anyone looking for a positive and effective fitness journey!

>Clean and well-maintained equipment
Positive and respectful vibe throughout the gym
>Knowledgeable trainers who take time to understand your goals
